variant.author: NeNeppie
variant.changelog:
**Moved to stable:**
- Automatic Crowdsourcing
  - Submissions are uploaded to Xivstats' database. Thanks to Infi.
  - Collects items & dyes used, weekly theme information and score.
  - Private or sensitive data is never collected.
  - Requires opt-in (plugin functionality is unaffected by your choice).
  - See how many times a particular piece was used among the userbase.
  - Sends a chat message when an upload fails.
- Onboarding window that explains everything.
- General refactor.
variant.description:
This plugin is a crowdsourced project, aiming to provide a comprehensive list for all hint categories.
See the github page for information on how you can contribute.
Open the Fashion Report window to get started!
variant.name: Avant-Garde
variant.punchline: Displays a list of valid gear pieces beside hints in the Fashion Report minigame.

variant.author: NeNeppie
variant.changelog:
- Now featuring dye statistics!
  - Find (or, well, try to) the correct dye for each slot.
  - Uses a weighting system to determine which dyes are correct.
  - View the confidence rating for each dye. Automically sorted by accuracy in descending order.
  - Actually not all that accurate currently, so take it with a big grain of salt and refer to more reliable sources.
- Changed the UI layout to accommodate the new dye windows.
- More refactoring.
